page.notes: Greek entries in the right column (ἐπιθεσις, ἐπιτιμος, ἐπισκοπᾶ) are doubtful and are marked [?]. Several numbers are blurred and uncertain, including 154 a, 926, 214 and 999 a; some Latin letters in the middle column (e.g. "Elimelech socer", "Lis patus") are read with difficulty. "Episcopatus in principatu versi" may be a shortened or misread heading. Some page numbers in the middle column are partly obscured. The entry "Esau" at the foot is a catchword, not a line of the index.
